snippet.title: Share With Your Friend! 🍪 Want for Others What You Want | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Imagine you get a big, yummy cookie! What would you want for your best friend?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) said: "None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself." (narrated by Anas bin Malik Radi Allahu Anhu)

So if you love a yummy cookie, share some with your friend. If you love being picked to play, pick your friend too. And if you love kind words, say kind words to your friend! What will your little one share with a friend today?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 13: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:13
